name: Premium 10x20 Custom Canopy Tent – HEX Aluminum Frame (Silver) with Three Full Walls & 17" Valance (Dye-Sublimation Printing)

categories.title: Custom Canopy Tents – Personalized Pop Up Tents for Events

descriptionHtml:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent

Elevate your event setup with our Premium 10'×20' Custom Canopy Tent, engineered for professional vendors who need maximum space, durability, and high-impact branding. This oversized canopy features a 40mm heavy-duty aluminum frame, a fully custom 600D dye-sublimation canopy, and includes three single-sided full walls for complete coverage, privacy, and strong visual presence. Comes complete with a wheeled carry bag and free nationwide FedEx ground shipping.

Key Features

🛡️ Durable 600D Polyester Canopy: Built with weather-resistant, long-lasting fabric ideal for outdoor use.
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation: High-resolution, fade-resistant printing on a crisp white canopy for vibrant artwork.
💪 Heavy-Duty Aluminum Frame: Constructed with 1.2 mm anodized aluminum for superior strength and reliability.
🔩 Reinforced ABS Hardware: ABS glass-filled nylon joints add durability and reduce wear.
📏 1.75" HEX-Shaped Legs: Hexagon legs for enhanced structural support and improved wind resistance.
⬆️ Pinch-Free Height Adjustment: Plastic lever system enables smooth, safe height changes.
🧱 Three Full Walls (Single-Sided): Provides maximum branding area, privacy, shade, and weather protection.
🧳 Portable & Convenient: Collapses easily and stows in the included wheeled soft carry bag for transport.
🪢 Secure Setup Required: Includes rope and peg kit; proper anchoring is required to maintain the warranty.
🖨️ Imprint Method: Premium full-color dye sublimation for crisp, long-lasting graphics.
🚚 Shipping: Free ground shipping (FedEx) nationwide.

Product Dimensions

  • 📐 Product Size: 120" W × 137" H × 240" D
  • 📦 Collapsible Size: 9.12" W × 62.75" H × 9.12" D
  • 🎒 Case Dimensions: 12.5" W × 56.25" H × 15.5" D
  • ⚖️ Product Weight: 40 lbs

Kit Includes

  • 🧩 1× Aluminum Frame
  • 🎪 1× Custom Printed Canopy
  • 🧱 3× Full Walls (Single-Sided)
  • 🧳 1× Wheeled Carry Bag
  • 🪢 1× Ropes & Pegs Set

Optional Accessories

  • 6' Table Cover
  • Feather Flags
  • Sandbags

Materials

  • 🔧 Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum
  • 🧵 Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

🔥 Meets FR Rating Requirements (Fire-Resistant)

Primary Usage

Outdoor events, trade shows, food booths, festivals, markets, brand activations, and vendor setups.

Factory Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
